questions.q: Which two courses in this catalog does this lesson say AI governance builds directly on?
options: Data Governance Foundations and Data Quality Management
Python Programming and SQL Server Fundamentals
Tableau and Advanced Excel
Git/GitHub/CI-CD and DevOps Engineering
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly builds on Data Governance Foundations (decision rights, roles) and Data Quality Management (quality dimensions).

questions.q: According to the lesson, what carries forward unchanged from existing data governance into AI governance?
options: Data owners and stewards still own the datasets feeding a model, and existing quality dimensions still define good data
Nothing — every role and standard must be rebuilt from scratch for AI
Only the company's logo and branding
The requirement that all data must be deleted before training a model
questions.explain: The lesson states that data-side roles and the quality dimensions carry forward and get extended, not replaced.

questions.q: Which of these does the lesson identify as something AI adds on top of existing data governance, without a direct equivalent?
options: The model itself as a new kind of asset that acts continuously once deployed
The concept of a spreadsheet
The existence of a company email system
Office building security badges
questions.explain: The lesson names the model-as-an-asset, training-specific data concerns, and production monitoring as the three new additions.

questions.q: Why does the lesson say skipping the data governance foundation causes AI governance efforts to fail?
options: Because model-specific controls like fairness testing mean little if nobody can vouch for where the training data came from
Because AI models cannot legally be built without a data governance team present
Because skipping it makes model training technically impossible
Because regulators require a data governance certificate before any model can run
questions.explain: The lesson's core warning is that building AI-specific controls on an ungoverned data foundation leaves those controls meaningless.

questions.q: Per the lesson, which quality dimensions from Data Quality Management get reused and will be applied specifically to training data later in this course?
options: Accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness
Font size, color scheme, and page layout
Server uptime, CPU usage, and disk space
Marketing reach, click-through rate, and conversion rate
questions.explain: These six dimensions are the ones this lesson says will be applied specifically to machine learning training data in Lesson 8.
